mapper.sql: case when dr.execution_status is not null and dr.execution_status != '' then lower(dr.execution_status) when eo.status is not null and eo.status != '' then lower(eo.status) when coalesce(dr.order_status, eo.order_status) = 'FILLED' then 'filled' when coalesce(dr.order_status, eo.order_status) = 'PARTIALLY_FILLED' then 'partial' when coalesce(dr.order_status, eo.order_status) = 'CANCELED' then 'canceled' when coalesce(dr.order_status, eo.order_status) = 'EXPIRED' then 'expired' when coalesce(dr.order_status, eo.order_status) = 'REJECTED' then 'failed' when coalesce(dr.order_status, eo.order_status) = 'BLOCKED' then 'blocked' when coalesce(dr.order_status, eo.order_status) = 'SKIPPED' then 'skipped' when coalesce(dr.order_status, eo.order_status) = 'SUBMITTED' then 'submitted' else 'pending' end
mapper.insert: insert into signal_event ( trace_id, symbol, signal_type, feature_json, created_at ) values ( #{traceId}, #{symbol}, #{signalType}, #{featureJson}, coalesce(#{createdAt}, current_timestamp) )

insert into feature_snapshot ( trace_id, symbol, event_strength, snapshot_json, created_at ) values ( #{traceId}, #{symbol}, #{eventStrength}, #{snapshotJson}, coalesce(#{createdAt}, current_timestamp) )
insert into signal_score ( signal_event_id, trace_id, signal_type, score, created_at ) values ( #{signalEventId}, #{traceId}, #{signalType}, #{score}, coalesce(#{createdAt}, current_timestamp) )

insert into signal_window_state ( trace_id, symbol, window_key, source_type, signal_type, direction, strength_score, decay_score, opened_at, expires_at, last_event_at, last_confirmed_at, dedupe_key, combine_until_at, is_active, state_json, created_at ) values ( #{traceId}, #{symbol}, #{windowKey}, #{sourceType}, #{signalType}, #{direction}, #{strengthScore}, #{decayScore}, #{openedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{lastEventAt}, #{lastConfirmedAt}, #{dedupeKey}, #{combineUntilAt}, #{active}, #{stateJson}, coalesce(#{createdAt}, current_timestamp) )

insert into agent_run ( trace_id, symbol, agent_name, event_strength, status, created_at ) values ( #{traceId}, #{symbol}, #{agentName}, #{eventStrength}, #{status}, coalesce(#{createdAt}, current_timestamp) )

insert into agent_observation ( agent_run_id, trace_id, agent_name, observation_type, observation_json, created_at ) values ( #{agentRunId}, #{traceId}, #{agentName}, #{observationType}, #{observationJson}, coalesce(#{createdAt}, current_timestamp) )

insert into agent_conclusion ( trace_id, agent_name, bias, confidence, reason, created_at ) values ( #{traceId}, #{agentName}, #{bias}, #{confidence}, #{reason}, coalesce(#{createdAt}, current_timestamp) )

insert into decision_run ( trace_id, symbol, mode, action, confidence, summary_reason, model_code, model_provider, prompt_source, binding_template_code, fallback_template_code, resolved_template_code, prompt_template_fallback_used, trigger_reason, trigger_source, dispatch_mode, selected_agents_json, combination_match_json, active_signal_refs_json, cooldown_blocked, budget_blocked, execution_status, order_status, trade_memory_status_json, lifecycle_status_json, created_at ) values ( #{traceId}, #{symbol}, #{mode}, #{action}, #{confidence}, #{summaryReason}, #{modelCode}, #{modelProvider}, #{promptSource}, #{bindingTemplateCode}, #{fallbackTemplateCode}, #{resolvedTemplateCode}, #{promptTemplateFallbackUsed}, #{triggerReason}, #{triggerSource}, #{dispatchMode}, #{selectedAgentsJson}, #{combinationMatchJson}, #{activeSignalRefsJson}, #{cooldownBlocked}, #{budgetBlocked}, #{executionStatus}, #{orderStatus}, #{tradeMemoryStatusJson}, #{lifecycleStatusJson}, coalesce(#{createdAt}, current_timestamp) )

insert into agent_message ( trace_id, agent_run_id, round_no, speaker_agent, target_agent, message_type, template_code, model_code, content_json, summary_text, created_at ) values ( #{traceId}, #{agentRunId}, #{roundNo}, #{speakerAgent}, #{targetAgent}, #{messageType}, #{templateCode}, #{modelCode}, #{contentJson}, #{summaryText}, coalesce(#{createdAt}, current_timestamp) )

insert into decision_action ( decision_run_id, trace_id, action, side, order_ref, execution_status, order_status, created_at ) values ( #{decisionRunId}, #{traceId}, #{action}, #{side}, #{orderRef}, #{executionStatus}, #{orderStatus}, coalesce(#{createdAt}, current_timestamp) )
mapper.select: select dr.id, dr.trace_id as traceId, dr.symbol, dr.mode, dr.action, dr.confidence, dr.summary_reason as summaryReason, dr.model_code as modelCode, dr.model_provider as modelProvider, dr.prompt_source as promptSource, dr.binding_template_code as bindingTemplateCode, dr.fallback_template_code as fallbackTemplateCode, dr.resolved_template_code as resolvedTemplateCode, dr.prompt_template_fallback_used as promptTemplateFallbackUsed, dr.trigger_reason as triggerReason, dr.trigger_source as triggerSource, dr.dispatch_mode as dispatchMode, dr.selected_agents_json as selectedAgentsJson, dr.combination_match_json as combinationMatchJson, dr.active_signal_refs_json as activeSignalRefsJson, dr.cooldown_blocked as cooldownBlocked, dr.budget_blocked as budgetBlocked, dr.execution_status as executionStatus, dr.order_status as orderStatus, dr.created_at as createdAt from decision_run dr order by dr.id desc
